text:
anya (PM): quick sync  need to pick behavior for prompt-sets in 'Scan' vs 'Review' modes on the evals scorecard. figma: https://figma.redwood/scorecard-density :mag_right:
ryan (Design): prefer action names: 'Scan / Review' instead of Compact/Detailed. Scan = fast triage
lee (Eng): constraint: cannot reorder DOM nodes; only collapse non-essential nodes or diffs break. we'll add stable data attributes for rows
nina (Product): in Scan we want icon-only approve inline; in Review a full labelled CTA + reason field. audit log should record which mode used
ryan (Design): add a subtle 'Scan mode' badge. icon-only needs accessible name though
marta (a11y): icon-only must have aria-label="Approve test". Scan reduces text contrast on chips -- needs stronger tokens to meet AA for small text
ina (Product): if a reviewer starts a comment in Scan should we expand row or open a flyout? I vote flyout to preserve list density
lee (Eng): flyout ok on desktop, modal on mobile. will implement focus trap and esc to return focus. also ensure toggling preserves focus context and announce mode change via aria-live
anya (PM): decisions: use 'Scan/Review' naming, icon approve in Scan, full CTA in Review, flyout desktop/modal mobile for comments, stable row ids for diffs. Lee to prototype keyboard + diff-id changes in a spike
devnull-bot: staging build scheduled: 2026-06-01T10:00Z will include Scan/Review toggle spike (frontend-only)
ryan (Design): i'll post two approve-affordance visuals (strong contrast variant + default) by EOD
marta (a11y): i'll run a quick screen-reader walkthrough once designs land
anya (PM): thanks, updating spec. follow-up: nina please schedule 2 short usability sessions for scan vs review flows. closing after Lee's demo link.
